sections.name: multi
sections.sig:
< multi (combine combine ...)
              (ignore)
              (max sink total 0.5 [])
              (max sink solute 0.9 [])
              (max sink secondary 1.5 [])
              (min sink total 0.01 []) >

attrs.name: combine
attrs.doc: List of chemistry parameterizations you want to combine.

attrs.name: ignore
attrs.doc:
Don’t warn when spraying one of these chemicals. The first time an untraced
        chemical not on the list is sprayed on the field, Daisy will issue a warning and
        add the chemical to this list.

attrs.name: max sink total
attrs.doc:
Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of total content.
        If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep in
        order to ensure that no more than this fraction of the total content is removed
        by drains or biopores within the timestep.

attrs.name: max sink solute
attrs.doc:
Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of solute content.
        If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep
        in order to ensure that no more than this fraction of the solute content is
        removed by drains or biopores within the timestep.

attrs.name: max sink secondary
attrs.doc:
Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of secondary domain content.
        If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep
        in order to ensure that no more than this fraction of the secondary domain
        content is removed by drains or biopores within the timestep. This should
        usually be above 1 to allow for the case where the secondary domain is emptied
        within a timestep.

attrs.name: min sink total
attrs.doc:
Always allow this fraction of total content to be removed by sink term.
     This overwrites all the ’max sink’ parameters.

attrs.name: trace
attrs.doc: List of chemicals in nested chemistries.

sections.text:
Handle multile chemistries.
  < multi (combine combine ...)
              (ignore)
              (max sink total 0.5 [])
              (max sink solute 0.9 [])
              (max sink secondary 1.5 [])
              (min sink total 0.01 []) >

       combine: chemistry component (see chapter 24) sequence
        List of chemistry parameterizations you want to combine.

       ignore: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        State variable (default: an empty sequence)
        Don’t warn when spraying one of these chemicals. The first time an untraced
        chemical not on the list is sprayed on the field, Daisy will issue a warning and
        add the chemical to this list.

       max sink total : number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.5)
        Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of total content.
        If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep in
        order to ensure that no more than this fraction of the total content is removed
        by drains or biopores within the timestep.

       max sink solute: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.9)
        Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of solute content.
        If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep
        in order to ensure that no more than this fraction of the solute content is
        removed by drains or biopores within the timestep.

       max sink secondary: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 1.5)
        Maximum allowed sink term as a fraction of secondary domain content.
        If variable timesteps are enabled, Daisy will try to scale down the timestep
        in order to ensure that no more than this fraction of the secondary domain
        content is removed by drains or biopores within the timestep. This should
        usually be above 1 to allow for the case where the secondary domain is emptied
        within a timestep.

       min sink total : number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.01)

     Always allow this fraction of total content to be removed by sink term.
     This overwrites all the ’max sink’ parameters.

Log Variables
    trace: chemical component (see chapter 23) sequence
     List of chemicals in nested chemistries.
